items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: There was a little band in Dallas where Blaine Johnson was here. That's the one that Richard McCawfield and myself and Richard Johnson came.

ctx.x: There was a little band in Dallas where Blaine Johnson was here. That's the one that Richard McCawfield and myself and Richard Johnson came. He was a very, very, very person that got sick and he would stop playing.
Oh, but did he play with you ever?
